_comment: All 64 NPCs from the original game (js/game.js lines 574-609, js/girls.js). Positions are MAP PIXELS.

idle: Stay safe and keep your ID card with you!

0: Good morning! Welcome to ANITS. First day?
The Admin Block is the big white building ahead with the ANITS sign on its roof. Your documents must be submitted there.
Walk down the main road and talk to Laksmi (Admin) at the office.
id: Stop! Students need to show their ID card at the gate.
Open your bag with the B key and press Show on your ID card.
id_done: Thank you! Welcome to ANITS. Go in!

idle: Your ID card is being printed. Please check later.

2: Ah, a new student! Please hand over your admission documents.
...Everything looks fine. Your ID card will be ready by evening.
Now go and meet Prof. Rao, the HOD of CSE. Walk straight through the central hallway of this building and you will reach the roads to every block. His block is the blue one beyond it.
day2: Fees? Yes, here is your fee slip. The total is Rs. 250.
Take cash from the bank first, then come back to pay me.
Thank you! Rs. 250 received. Here is your receipt.
Now show this receipt to Prof. Rao.
day4: A library card? Fill this form, then go to the library in the west wing.
Answer a small quiz there and the librarian will issue your card.
day7: Stamp done. Take it back to Suresh quickly!

3: Welcome to the CSE department! I am Prof. Rao.
This semester you need a lab manual. Collect it from Suresh at the IT Block, the tall building on the east side.
And remember, ANITS is not only about studies.
day2: Ah, the fee receipt. Very good, you are officially a student!
day3: Your classroom? Check the west wing, Room 204.
Hurry, the first bell rings soon.
day7: Signature done. Now take the stamp from Laksmi (Admin).
day10: Welcome to your first class! Let us begin with a short quiz.
Excellent! Class dismissed. Welcome to ANITS, your best four years begin now!

idle: Labs open at 9. Do not forget your record!

4: Hello! Your lab manual? Here it is, still warm from the printer.
The canteen is just up the road near the Civil Block. Your friend Arjun is waiting for you there.
day4: Your library card is ready! Please keep silence inside.
day7: Lab manual run! Get Prof. Rao's signature first.
Perfect! All signatures are complete. Lab entry unlocked!

idle: Chai and samosa, the perfect combo!

5: Hey! You made it! Come, chai is on me.
Tip: there are cold-drink vending machines at both canteens, here and near the main gate. Stand in front and press E to buy a drink!
Listen, the NCC cadets are on the big ground near the power station.
If you give their Colonel a proper salute, the whole company will remember you. Stand near him and press G!
day3: Hey! Over here! I saved you a seat in the right room!
day5: Super shots! You are a proper player!
day8: You won! Chai and samosa are on me!
day9: Your dance was super! Everybody clapped!

6: Stand tall, young man! In the NCC we greet with a salute.
Come close and press G to salute.
7: Jai Hind! A fine salute, cadet.
Welcome to ANITS, fresher. May this college be the best chapter of your life.
You survived your first day. Well done!
day6: Cadet, today is the parade drill. Follow my commands sharply!
Excellent parade! You marched like a true cadet. Jai Hind!

idle: Jai Hind! Sir is watching, I cannot talk now!

route_student_lines: Hey! New here? The canteen next to the Civil Block makes the best chai.
Parking fills up by 9 AM. Come early next time!
The CSE labs are on the upper floor. Good luck!
Our NCC cadets practise on the big ground every morning.
Exams are near... I need to study. See you later!
Basketball ground is open after 4 PM. Join us!
basketball_lines: Nice shot! Come play after class.

named_walkers.name: Ravi
lines: Hey! Ravi here, CSE second year. Need any help finding a class?
The labs upstairs are cold, carry a jacket!

named_walkers.name: Kiran
lines: I am rushing to the library before the queue gets long.
Have you collected your lab manual yet?

named_walkers.name: Teja
lines: Hi! Teja, ECE. The canteen samosas run out by noon, go early!
Parking is a mess today, ha.

named_walkers.name: Harsha
lines: Late again! The professor will kill me.
First day? Do not worry, it gets easier.

named_walkers.name: Vamsi
lines: Bro, did you see the NCC parade this morning? So sharp!
I am heading to the canteen for chai.

named_walkers.name: Charan
lines: Exams are near and I have not opened a single book...
Do you know a good notes shop around here?

named_walkers.name: Sai
lines: Hello! Sai from IT. If you need project partners, find me.
The fest rehearsals start this week!

named_walkers.name: Mahesh
lines: I just got my ID card renewed. Bajirao is strict but fair.
Salute the Colonel when you pass the ground, he likes it.

named_walkers.name: Naveen
lines: Do not sit in the front bench if you did not do the assignment!
Cold drinks from the vending machine are a lifesaver in this heat.

named_walkers.name: Dinesh
lines: I am looking for my friend, have you seen a guy in a blue shirt?
Welcome to ANITS!

standing.name: Anil
lines: We are waiting for the chai to cool, ha ha.
Join us! The canteen is the best place on campus.

standing.name: Pavan
lines: Anil never finishes his tea, he just talks.
Have you met Prof. Rao yet? He is nice.

standing.name: Rohit
lines: Shh, I am revising for the test.
The library is quiet, but outside it is nicer.

standing.name: Varun
lines: We are discussing the assignment. Want to join?
First years always look lost on day one!

standing.name: Manoj
lines: I come early to watch the NCC drill, it is impressive.
Colonel Singh is very strict about discipline.

standing.name: Girish
lines: Bajirao knows everyone by name, even the visitors!
The gate is busiest at nine.

standing.name: Sunil
lines: Nice court, right? Come play after class.
I score more than I attend class!

standing.name: Deepak
lines: Pass the ball! Oh, hi there.
Freshers' match is coming up, join our team.

remy.name: Remy (Student)
lines: Hey! I'm Remy, second year. First day at ANITS?
Tip: the canteen near the Civil Block has the best chai.
Sorry, I have to run. I'm late for class!

girls.name: Divya
lines: Oh hi! Sorry, I'm running late to submit my lab record!
If you see Prof. Rao, tell him I'm coming right now!
Running is my morning exercise. Join me if you can keep up!

girls.name: Anjali
lines: Hi! I'm Anjali, ECE first year. Which block are you looking for?
The Admin Block is the big one near the main road. Ms. Laksmi makes you wait a little, so be patient!
Bye! I need to catch the bus before it leaves.

girls.name: Priya
lines: Hey fresher! I'm Priya. I'm rushing to the library before the books are gone.
Tip: the library has the best AC on campus. Perfect for studying.
See you around! Don't forget your ID card.

girls.name: Sneha
lines: Hi! Sneha from CSE. Fest rehearsals are starting, I'm late again!
We need dancers for the fest stage. Come try out if you like!
Okay, I must dash now. Take care!

girls.name: Kavya
lines: Hello! I'm Kavya. Have you tried the samosas at the canteen yet?
They run out by noon, so go early. And the chai is great too!
Catch you later, I'm racing my friends to the canteen!

girls.name: Pooja
lines: Hi! I'm Pooja. This is my first week too, everything feels so big!
I keep getting lost. The roads here all look the same to me.
If you find the way to the lab, please tell me!

girls.name: Meena
lines: Namaste! I'm Meena, third year. Ask me anything about the campus.
Be polite to Ms. Laksmi in the office, and she will help you quickly.
Good luck with your first day!

girls.name: Swathi
lines: Shh... I'm memorising my notes for the test.
Do you know the answers to the Python quiz? Just kidding!
Okay, back to studying. Bye!

girls.name: Roja
lines: Hi there! I'm Roja. I come from a village near Vizag, and ANITS is my dream college.
The sea breeze reaches here some days. Isn't it lovely?
Enjoy your day!
